title: A Congressional Call to Prosecute Trump

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Marc Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是 Benjamin Poulin，我是 Marc Ronson，欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当 DJ 的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着 300 件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《The Reframers》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的 Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《The Daily》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是……

sentences.en: The Congressional Committee investigating the January 6th attack on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 负责调查 1 月 6 日美国国会大厦遇袭事件的国会委员会，

sentences.en: Capitol has recommended that former President Donald Trump be charged with four crimes, including insurrection.
sentences.zh: 已建议对前总统唐纳德·特朗普提出四项刑事指控，其中包括煽动叛乱。

sentences.en: My colleague, Luke Broadwater, was in the room as it happened.
sentences.zh: 我的同事 Luke Broadwater 当时就在现场。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 12 月 20 日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Luke, this long, strange journey is now over.
sentences.zh: 那么，Luke，这段漫长而离奇的旅程现在结束了。

sentences.en: The January 6th committee has just finished its 11th and final public meeting and really finished this historic project of investigating what happened before and on that very dark day.
sentences.zh: 1 月 6 日调查委员会刚刚结束了第 11 次也是最后一次公开会议，真正完成了这项历史性的工程，调查了在那黑暗的一天之前以及当天究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: And I know that you have tucked yourself into a little phone booth inside the Capitol, which I know can be very loud.
sentences.zh: 我知道你把自己塞进了国会大厦里的一个小电话亭里，我知道那里可能会很吵。

sentences.en: So, thank you for being willing to talk to us from there.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你愿意从那里接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: So, I'm curious, since you just walked out of the room where this last meeting was held, what is your reaction to it?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，既然你刚从举行最后一次会议的房间里走出来，你对此有什么反应？

sentences.en: Well, I think every step of the way, the January 6th committee has been a history-making congressional investigation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为 1 月 6 日调查委员会的每一步都是一次创造历史的国会调查。

sentences.en: If you look at how deep and wide their investigation went, it's pretty unprecedented in the annals of American democracy.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看他们调查的深度和广度，这在美国民主史上是相当空前的。

sentences.en: They interviewed more than 1,000 witnesses.
sentences.zh: 他们采访了 1000 多名证人。

sentences.en: They obtained more than a million documents.
sentences.zh: 他们获取了超过一百万份文件。

sentences.en: They issued easily more than 100 subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 他们发出的传票绝对超过了 100 张。

sentences.en: And so, as I'm watching this, I'm seeing a congressional committee go where Congress has not gone before.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我观察这一切时，我看到一个国会委员会走到了国会以前从未涉足的领域。

sentences.en: Most congressional investigations end with a report, maybe some legislative recommendations.
sentences.zh: 大多数国会调查以一份报告或一些立法建议告终。

sentences.en: They don't end with lawmakers sitting up at a dais telling the Justice Department what crimes a former president committed and how he should be investigated.
sentences.zh: 它们不会以议员们坐在主席台上，告诉司法部一位前总统犯了什么罪以及应该如何调查他而结束。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell us exactly how it is they go about doing that last piece of history-making.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么请告诉我们他们究竟是如何完成这最后一步历史性举措的。

sentences.en: What happens in this final meeting?
sentences.zh: 这次最后会议上发生了什么？

sentences.en: Unlike the committee's previous hearings this summer, which were quite lengthy and full of detailed evidence, this meeting on Monday was designed to be efficient.
sentences.zh: 与今年夏天委员会之前那些冗长且充满详细证据的听证会不同，周一的这次会议旨在提高效率。

sentences.en: A quorum being present, the select committee to investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol will be in order.
sentences.zh: 法定人数已到，负责调查 1 月 6 日美国国会大厦遇袭事件的特别委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: The purpose of this meeting was to remind the American people of the important points along the way at which Donald Trump and his allies attempted to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 这次会议的目的是提醒美国人民，唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友试图推翻选举过程中的重要节点。

sentences.en: And so, Benny Thompson, the chairman of the committee, a Democrat from Mississippi, opens the hearing and laid out sort of the broad principles that were at play here.
sentences.zh: 因此，委员会主席、来自密西西比州的民主党人 Benny Thompson 开启了听证会，并阐述了这里所涉及的一些基本原则。

sentences.en: To cast a vote in the United States is an act of faith and hope.
sentences.zh: 在美国投票是一种信仰和希望的行为。

sentences.en: When we drop that ballot in the ballot box, we expect the people named on the ballot are going to uphold that end of the deal.
sentences.zh: 当我们把选票投入票箱时，我们期望选票上的人能够履行他们的承诺。

sentences.en: About the importance of a president admitting when he lost and turning over the reins of government to the person who beat him.
sentences.zh: 关于总统在落选时承认失败并将政府权力移交给击败他的人的重要性。

sentences.en: Those who come up short ultimately accept the results and abide by the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 那些失败的人最终会接受结果并遵守法治。

sentences.en: That faith in our system is the foundation of American democracy.
sentences.zh: 对我们制度的这种信仰是美国民主的基石。

sentences.en: If the faith is broken, so is our democracy.
sentences.zh: 如果这种信仰破灭，我们的民主也就随之破灭。

sentences.en: Donald Trump broke that faith.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普打破了这种信仰。

sentences.en: Donald Trump refused to admit he loSt.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普拒绝承认他输了。

sentences.en: But he chose to try to stay in office through a multi-part scheme to overturn the results and block the transfer of power.
sentences.zh: 但他选择试图通过一个多环节的计划来推翻结果并阻止权力移交，从而留在职位上。

sentences.en: And for that, Chairman Thompson said, he needs to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，Thompson 主席表示，他必须承担责任。

sentences.en: If we are to survive as a nation of laws and democracy, this can never happen again.
sentences.zh: 如果我们作为一个法治和民主的国家想要生存下去，这种情况绝不能再发生。

sentences.en: How do we stop it?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何阻止它？

sentences.en: There's one factor I believe is most important in preventing another January 6th.
sentences.zh: 我相信有一个因素对于防止另一次“1 月 6 日”事件最为重要。

sentences.en: Accountability.
sentences.zh: 问责。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember thinking when he used that word accountability, he's hinting at not just what's to come, but why it must come.
sentences.zh: 我记得当他用到“问责”这个词时，我心想，他不仅是在暗示即将发生的事情，还在暗示为什么必须发生。

sentences.en: Why this committee will be recommending criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 为什么这个委员会要建议提出刑事指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This whole hearing was laying the groundwork, laying the argument for what the panel planned to do at the end.
sentences.zh: 整个听证会都是在铺垫基础，为委员会计划在最后做的事情提供论据。

sentences.en: And that was issuing the criminal referrals.
sentences.zh: 那就是发布刑事移交建议。

sentences.en: And so what Chairman Thompson is doing here is he's reminding the public once again of exactly what Donald Trump did.
sentences.zh: 所以 Thompson 主席在这里所做的，是再次提醒公众唐纳德·特朗普究竟做了什么。

sentences.en: And he starts to utilize the rest of the committee.
sentences.zh: 他开始利用委员会的其他成员。

sentences.en: I especially want to thank and acknowledge our vice chair.
sentences.zh: 我特别想感谢并表彰我们的副主席。

sentences.en: To lay out this case, he kicks the mic to Liz Cheney, the vice chairwoman from Wyoming, who...
sentences.zh: 为了陈述这个案件，他把话筒交给了来自怀俄明州的副主席 Liz Cheney，她……

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman, and thank you for your...
sentences.zh: 非常感谢主席先生，也感谢你的……

sentences.en: ...starts to remind the public of how Donald Trump did nothing.
sentences.zh: ……开始提醒公众唐纳德·特朗普是如何无所作为的。

sentences.en: Among the most shameful of this committee's findings was that President Trump sat in the dining room off the Oval Office watching the violent riot at the Capitol on television.
sentences.zh: 本委员会最令人羞愧的发现之一是，特朗普总统坐在椭圆形办公室旁的餐厅里，在电视上看着国会大厦发生的暴力骚乱。

sentences.en: And then we hear from other members about various ways Donald Trump attempted to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 然后我们从其他成员那里听到了唐纳德·特朗普试图推翻选举的各种方式。

sentences.en: The president's January 2nd, 2021 call to Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger, in which the president urged the secretary to find 11,780 votes.
sentences.zh: 总统在 2021 年 1 月 2 日给佐治亚州州务卿 Brad Raffensperger 打了电话，总统敦促州务卿“找到”11780 张选票。

sentences.en: He needed to change the outcome in that state.
sentences.zh: 他需要改变那个州的选举结果。

sentences.en: One member spoke of how Donald Trump furthered what she called the big lie.
sentences.zh: 一位成员谈到了唐纳德·特朗普是如何推进她所说的“弥天大谎”的。

sentences.en: The big lie.
sentences.zh: 弥天大谎。

sentences.en: The enormous effort led by ex-president Trump to spread baseless accusations and misinformation in an attempt to...
sentences.zh: 由特朗普前总统领导的巨大努力，旨在散布毫无根据的指控和虚假信息，试图……

sentences.en: They talked about how Donald Trump pressured the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了唐纳德·特朗普是如何向司法部施压的。

sentences.en: How he even pressured his own vice president.
sentences.zh: 他甚至向他自己的副总统施压。

sentences.en: In multiple heated conversations, President Trump directly pressured Vice President Pence to adopt the Eastman theory
sentences.zh: 在多次激烈的谈话中，特朗普总统直接向彭斯副总统施压，要求他采纳 Eastman 理论，

sentences.en: and either reject the electors or send them back to the state legislatures.
sentences.zh: 要么拒绝选举人票，要么把它们送回州议会。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: He personally asked for us to come to D.C.
sentences.zh: 他亲自要求我们那天来到华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: that day.
sentences.zh: 那天。

sentences.en: They played evidence time and time again from rioters themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们一次又一次地播放了来自骚乱者本人的证据。

sentences.en: And I thought, for everything he's done for us, if this is the only thing he's going to ask of me, I'll do it.
sentences.zh: 我想，为了他为我们所做的一切，如果这是他唯一要求我做的事，我会去做。

sentences.en: Who, as they're storming the Capitol, say they're doing it because they believe that's what Donald Trump wants them to do.
sentences.zh: 那些在冲击国会大厦时说他们这样做是因为他们相信这就是唐纳德·特朗普想要他们做的人。

sentences.en: One of the new pieces of evidence they introduced was video from a White House aide named Hope Hicks, who recalled a one-on-one conversation she had with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们引入的新证据之一是来自白宫助手 Hope Hicks 的视频，她回忆了她与唐纳德·特朗普进行的一次一对一谈话。

sentences.en: I was seeing evidence of fraud on a scale that would have impacted the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 我看到了足以影响选举结果的欺诈证据。

sentences.en: And I was becoming increasingly concerned that we were damaging his legacy.
sentences.zh: 我越来越担心我们正在损害他的政治遗产。

sentences.en: What did the president say in response to what you just described?
sentences.zh: 总统对你刚才描述的情况有什么回应？

sentences.en: He said something along the lines of, you know, nobody will care about my legacy if I lose.
sentences.zh: 他说了一些类似这样的话：你知道，如果我输了，没人会在乎我的政治遗产。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump didn't seem to care, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，唐纳德·特朗普似乎并不在乎。

sentences.en: So that won't matter.
sentences.zh: 所以那不重要。

sentences.en: The only thing that matters is winning.
sentences.zh: 唯一重要的是赢。

sentences.en: The only thing he cared about was winning, not about his legacy.
sentences.zh: 他唯一在乎的就是赢，而不是他的政治遗产。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in doing this, Luke, it struck me that the committee was not just running through the hits of these hearings and how much evidence they have revealed.
sentences.zh: Luke，在做这件事时，我注意到委员会不仅仅是在回顾这些听证会的重点以及他们揭露了多少证据。

sentences.en: They're also, in a way, laying out a legal case.
sentences.zh: 他们也在某种程度上是在陈述一个法律案件。

sentences.en: I mean, I think about that Hope Hicks testimony as motivation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为 Hope Hicks 的证词是动机所在。

sentences.en: I mean, here's a president saying, I won't stop making these false claims because I have to win.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里有一位总统说，我不会停止散布这些虚假声明，因为我必须赢。

sentences.en: If I don't win, nothing else matters.
sentences.zh: 如果我不赢，其他一切都不重要。

sentences.en: Then you have evidence of his actual conduct.
sentences.zh: 然后你有他实际行为的证据。

sentences.en: Then his behavior during the actual riot and his indifference to it.
sentences.zh: 然后是他骚乱期间的行为以及他对骚乱的冷漠。

sentences.en: And so this was not just a highlight reel.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是一个精彩片段集锦。

sentences.en: It was almost kind of a summary of a legal case.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是对一个法律案件的总结。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: And so, you know, a little of the backstory of how this hearing came about was a team of the four lawyers on the committee,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，关于这次听证会是如何产生的背景故事是，委员会的四名律师团队，

sentences.en: Jamie Raskin, Liz Cheney, Zoe Lofgren, and Adam Schiff, have been working for weeks to study the case for criminal referrals.
sentences.zh: Jamie Raskin、Liz Cheney、Zoe Lofgren 和 Adam Schiff，已经工作了数周来研究刑事移交建议的案件。

sentences.en: And so as these lawyers were looking through the legal code and studying exactly what the elements of various crimes were,
sentences.zh: 因此，当这些律师查阅法律条文并研究各种犯罪的构成要素时，

sentences.en: they were matching up evidence in their treasure trove of interviews and documents to specifically match certain acts to certain crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们正在将他们采访和文件宝库中的证据进行匹配，以专门将某些行为与某些罪行对应起来。

sentences.en: And so every clip they played at this hearing, every piece of testimony they put forward was done with that purpose in mind,
sentences.zh: 所以他们在这次听证会上播放的每一个片段，提出的每一份证词，都是带着这个目的进行的，

sentences.en: with building a certain case against Donald Trump or one of his allies on one of these specific charges.
sentences.zh: 旨在针对唐纳德·特朗普或他的盟友之一建立针对这些具体指控的案件。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: OK, so what happens next?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: The chair recognizes a gentleman from Maryland, Mr. Raskin, for an opening statement.
sentences.zh: 主席请来自马里兰州的绅士 Raskin 先生作开场陈述。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生。

sentences.en: Then, Jamie Raskin, the Democrat from Maryland who's a constitutional law professor, gets his turn to speak.
sentences.zh: 然后，来自马里兰州的民主党人、宪法法学教授 Jamie Raskin 轮到他发言了。

sentences.en: Several months ago,
sentences.zh: 几个月前，

sentences.en: you tasked several of our members in a subcommittee with bringing recommendations to the full committee about potential referrals to the Department of Justice and other authorities.
sentences.zh: 你指派我们小组委员会的几名成员向全体委员会提出关于向司法部和其他当局进行潜在移交的建议。

sentences.en: And up on the screen pops the words, everyone in the room's been waiting for, criminal referrals.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上弹出了房间里每个人都在等待的词：刑事移交建议。

sentences.en: We are now prepared to share those recommendations today.
sentences.zh: 我们现在准备在今天分享这些建议。

sentences.en: Now, what is a criminal referral?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是刑事移交建议？

sentences.en: It is essentially a recommendation from Congress to the Justice Department that says,
sentences.zh: 它本质上是国会向司法部提出的一项建议，意思是：

sentences.en: based on our investigation, we believe that you should investigate and potentially charge the following people for the following crimes.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的调查，我们认为你们应该调查并可能起诉以下人员犯有以下罪行。

sentences.en: And it's very clear, as Jamie Raskin is talking, that he has issues of fairness on his mind.
sentences.zh: 很明显，当 Jamie Raskin 在说话时，他心里想的是公平问题。

sentences.en: The dangerous assault on American constitutional democracy that took place on January 6th, 2021, consists of hundreds of individual criminal offenses.
sentences.zh: 2021 年 1 月 6 日发生的对美国宪法民主的危险攻击，由数百起个人刑事犯罪组成。

sentences.en: Most such crimes are already being prosecuted by the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 大多数此类犯罪已经由司法部起诉。

sentences.en: Ours is not a system of justice where foot soldiers go to jail and the masterminds and ringleaders get a free pass.
sentences.zh: 我们的司法制度不是那种让小卒坐牢，而让幕后黑手和头目逍遥法外的制度。

sentences.en: He's thinking of the 700, 800 people who were on the Capitol grounds that day and invaded the Capitol who have been charged with crimes while no political actors have been.
sentences.zh: 他想到的是那天在国会大厦场地并入侵国会大厦的 700、800 人，他们被指控犯罪，而没有任何政治人物被指控。

sentences.en: Both former President Donald Trump and John Eastman likely violated two federal criminal statutes.
sentences.zh: 前总统唐纳德·特朗普和 John Eastman 很可能违反了两项联邦刑事法规。

sentences.en: Then he names two of the masterminds.
sentences.zh: 然后他点名了两个幕后黑手。

sentences.en: John Eastman, a conservative lawyer who those who have watched the hearings have gotten to know pretty well
sentences.zh: John Eastman，一位保守派律师，看过听证会的人对他已经很熟悉了，

sentences.en: because he's the guy who comes up with this legal theory for overturning the election.
sentences.zh: 因为他就是那个提出推翻选举法律理论的人。

sentences.en: And then he names the biggest mastermind of all, Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 然后他点名了最大的幕后黑手：特朗普本人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是 Andrew Ross-Sorkin。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: Vance、Elon Musk、Christine Lagarde、Zilran Mondani 等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So, Luke, tell us about the criminal referrals that Raskin outlines when it comes to these two big-name alleged masterminds,
sentences.zh: 那么，Luke，请告诉我们 Raskin 在谈到这两位大名鼎鼎的所谓幕后黑手时概述的刑事移交建议，

sentences.en: John Eastman and President Trump.
sentences.zh: 即 John Eastman 和特朗普总统。

sentences.en: The first criminal statute we invoke for referral, therefore, is Title 18, Section 1512C.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们援引进行移交建议的第一项刑事法规是《美国法典》第 18 卷第 1512C 条。

sentences.en: The first criminal code that Congressman Raskin puts up on the screen is obstruction of an official proceeding, the certifying of Joe Biden's election in Congress.
sentences.zh: Raskin 议员在屏幕上打出的第一条刑法是妨碍官方程序，即国会对乔·拜登选举结果的认证。

sentences.en: The central moment for the lawful transfer of power in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是美国合法权力移交的核心时刻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just to summarize this, I mean, the charge here is that the president, and in this case his lawyer,
sentences.zh: 总结一下，我的意思是，这里的指控是总统，在本案中是他的律师，

sentences.en: have intentionally sought to subvert the regular course of democracy on the most basic level, which is, of course, what January 6th was about.
sentences.zh: 有意图地试图在最基本的层面上颠覆民主的正常进程，这当然就是 1 月 6 日事件的本质。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Second, we believe that there is more than sufficient evidence to refer former President Donald J.
sentences.zh: 第二，我们认为有充分的证据将前总统唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普移交司法部。

sentences.en: So, the second charge they bring up is called conspiracy to defraud the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们提出的第二项指控被称为共谋欺诈美国。

sentences.en: In other words, to make an agreement to impair, obstruct, or defeat the lawful functions of the United States government by deceitful or dishonest means.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是达成协议，通过欺骗或不诚实的手段损害、阻碍或破坏美国政府的合法职能。

sentences.en: And this is a count that has to do with all the lying, all the false documents that Donald Trump and his allies engaged in.
sentences.zh: 这是一项与唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友参与的所有谎言和虚假文件有关的罪名。

sentences.en: Lying to the public about him being the true winner of the election, about Dominion voting machines rigging the election.
sentences.zh: 向公众撒谎说他是选举的真正赢家，说 Dominion 投票机操纵了选举。

sentences.en: Our report describes in detail the actions of numerous co-conspirators who agreed with and participated in Trump's plan.
sentences.zh: 我们的报告详细描述了众多同意并参与特朗普计划的共同阴谋者的行为。

sentences.en: In the written version of this charge, of this criminal referral, the committee names several other allies,
sentences.zh: 在这项指控的文本版本中，即这份刑事移交建议中，委员会点名了其他几位盟友，

sentences.en: including Rudy Giuliani, the president's campaign lawyer, and Mark Meadows, the president's former chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 包括总统的竞选律师 Rudy Giuliani 和总统的前幕僚长 Mark Meadows。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Third, we make a referral based on Title 18...
sentences.zh: 第三，我们根据美国法典第18编提出移交建议……

sentences.en: Then they move on to conspiracy to make a false statement.
sentences.zh: 然后他们转向了串谋作伪证的指控。

sentences.en: The evidence clearly suggests that President Trump conspired with others to submit slates of fake electors to Congress and the National Archives.
sentences.zh: 证据清楚地表明，特朗普总统与他人串谋，向国会和国家档案馆提交了伪造的选举人名单。

sentences.en: We're talking about the same sort of elements of the crime, interrupting the congressional proceeding, putting forward the fake electors.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是同类犯罪要素，即干扰国会程序、提交伪造的选举人名单。

sentences.en: And again, Donald Trump and John Eastman are named.
sentences.zh: 同样，唐纳德·特朗普和约翰·伊斯特曼也被点名了。

sentences.en: The fourth and final statute we invoke for referral is Title 18, Section 2383.
sentences.zh: 我们援引进行移交的第四项也是最后一项法规是美国法典第18编第2383条。

sentences.en: And finally, we come to perhaps the most consequential charge.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们谈谈或许是最重大的指控。

sentences.en: The statute applies to anyone who incites, assists, or engages in insurrection againSt...
sentences.zh: 该法规适用于任何煽动、协助或参与叛乱的人……

sentences.en: And that is the charge of insurrection.
sentences.zh: 那就是叛乱罪。

sentences.en: An insurrection is a rebellion against the authority of the United States.
sentences.zh: 叛乱是对美国权威的反抗。

sentences.en: It is a grave federal offense, anchored in the Constitution itself, which repeatedly opposes insurrections and domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 这是一项严重的联邦罪行，根植于宪法本身，宪法一再反对叛乱和国内暴力。

sentences.en: And for this referral, the committee focuses solely on Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 对于这次移交，委员会仅关注特朗普本人。

sentences.en: The committee believes that more than sufficient evidence exists for a criminal referral of former President Trump for assisting or aiding and comforting those at the Capitol who engaged in a violent attack on the United States.
sentences.zh: 委员会认为，有充分的证据可以对前总统特朗普进行刑事移交，因为他协助、帮助并慰藉了国会大厦中参与暴力袭击美国的人。

sentences.en: Nothing could be a greater betrayal of this duty than to assist in insurrection against the constitutional order.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比协助针对宪法秩序的叛乱更背叛这一职责了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: So, Luke, how does this meeting end?
sentences.zh: 那么，卢克，这次会议是如何结束的？

sentences.en: Well, the very last act the committee takes at this business meeting is to put these criminal referrals up for a vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，委员会在这次商务会议上采取的最后一项行动就是对这些刑事移交建议进行投票。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, I move that the committee favorably report to the House the select committee's final report.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我提议委员会将特别委员会的最终报告呈交众议院。

sentences.en: And if there was any doubt that there was any dissension on the committee or conflict about what to do, it wasn't apparent up at the dais.
sentences.zh: 如果说委员会内部对该怎么做有任何分歧或冲突，那么在主席台上是看不出来的。

sentences.en: The clerk will call the roll.
sentences.zh: 书记员将进行点名表决。

sentences.en: Ms. Cheney.
sentences.zh: 切尼女士。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Ms. Lofgren.
sentences.zh: 洛夫格伦女士。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Mr. Kinzinger.
sentences.zh: 金辛格先生。

sentences.en: All nine members of the committee.
sentences.zh: 委员会所有九名成员。

sentences.en: Mr. Schiff.
sentences.zh: 希夫先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Seven Democrats and two Republicans.
sentences.zh: 七名民主党人和两名共和党人。

sentences.en: Mrs. Murphy.
sentences.zh: 墨菲夫人。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, you are not recorded.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，您还没有投票记录。

sentences.en: Chair votes aye.
sentences.zh: 主席投赞成票。

sentences.en: Voted to endorse criminal referrals against Donald Trump and some of his top allies and send those referrals to the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 投票支持对唐纳德·特朗普及其一些核心盟友进行刑事移交，并将这些建议移交给司法部。

sentences.en: There being no further business, without objection, the select committee stands adjoined.
sentences.zh: 如果没有其他事项，且无异议，特别委员会休会。

sentences.en: Look, I think it's worth pausing to reflect on the enormity of a bipartisan group of lawmakers recommending criminal charges be brought against a former president, in this case,
sentences.zh: 听着，我认为值得停下来反思一下，两党议员团体建议对一位前总统提起刑事指控的严重性，在这种情况下，

sentences.en: a former president who is now a declared candidate for president again in 2024 for all these charges, but especially for the charge of insurrection.
sentences.zh: 这位前总统现在已经宣布参加2024年总统竞选，面对所有这些指控，尤其是叛乱罪的指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, when you think about it, it's almost mind-blowing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你仔细想想，这简直令人震惊。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Congress is determining this former president essentially presided over a self-coup against his own government.
sentences.zh: 国会认定这位前总统本质上是在策划一场针对自己政府的自我政变。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the very person he sought to steal the election from is in the White House presiding over the Justice Department, who Congress is recommending should investigate Trump.
sentences.zh: 而他试图窃取选举结果的对象，如今正坐在白宫主持司法部，而国会正建议该部门调查特朗普。

sentences.en: It really is a completely unique situation in American history.
sentences.zh: 这在美国历史上确实是一个完全独特的情况。

sentences.en: But it's a situation that Congress feels they have a duty to recommend these criminal referrals because no president ever in American history did what he did.
sentences.zh: 但国会认为他们有责任提出这些刑事移交建议，因为美国历史上从未有总统做过他所做的事。

sentences.en: But here, Luke,
sentences.zh: 但在这里，卢克，

sentences.en: I think we have to reckon with the limits of what this enormous moment that you and I are describing means and how much of a criminal referral from the House of Representatives is symbolic and how much of it has real-world implications.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须考虑到你我所描述的这一重大时刻的局限性，以及众议院的刑事移交建议有多少是象征性的，又有多少具有现实意义。

sentences.en: So just remind us of all that.
sentences.zh: 所以请提醒我们所有这些。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, it is a symbolic act, but it is a powerfully symbolic act.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一种象征性行为，但它是一种强有力的象征性行为。

sentences.en: It is the United States Congress saying we've thrown every resource imaginable into this investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是美国国会在说，我们已经投入了所有能想到的资源来进行这项调查。

sentences.en: And these are our conclusions.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我们的结论。

sentences.en: And we wish we had the power to charge, but we don't.
sentences.zh: 我们希望我们有权起诉，但我们没有。

sentences.en: And so the ball is now in your court.
sentences.zh: 所以现在球在你们那边了。

sentences.en: Now, of course, it doesn't oblige the Justice Department to do anything.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不强制司法部做任何事情。

sentences.en: The Justice Department doesn't have to listen to Congress.
sentences.zh: 司法部不必听从国会的。

sentences.en: But it does create a tremendous amount of public pressure, and it will be hard for the Justice Department to simply ignore them.
sentences.zh: 但它确实产生了巨大的公众压力，司法部很难简单地忽视它们。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Luke, these criminal referrals, they are not just the culmination of an investigation, but really of a kind of national event, right?
sentences.zh: 卢克，这些刑事移交建议，它们不仅是一项调查的终点，更是一种国家级事件，对吧？

sentences.en: This set of televised meetings, unlike anything in my lifetime, structured to be riveting, dramatic television,
sentences.zh: 这一系列电视转播的会议，在我有生之年从未见过，旨在成为引人入胜、戏剧性的电视节目，

sentences.en: and that produced a set of really shocking bombshells about a moment when our democracy truly teetered on the edge.
sentences.zh: 并产生了一系列关于我们民主真正处于边缘时刻的令人震惊的重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: So I want to end this conversation by asking what you have come to understand as the impact of the committee's total body of work now that it's over.
sentences.zh: 所以我想以询问你对委员会全部工作成果的影响的理解来结束这次谈话，现在它已经结束了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I think the committee has been groundbreaking in a number of ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为委员会在许多方面都是开创性的。

sentences.en: One, with its televised hearings, it clearly set a new standard for how a congressional hearing could be conducted and produced.
sentences.zh: 第一，通过电视听证会，它显然为国会听证会如何进行和制作设定了新标准。

sentences.en: These streamlined, captivating narratives that brought in millions and millions of viewers, both in prime time and during the day,
sentences.zh: 这些精简、引人入胜的叙述吸引了数以千万计的观众，无论是在黄金时段还是白天，

sentences.en: which is something that really does not happen in Congress.
sentences.zh: 这在国会中确实不会发生。

sentences.en: I mean, most congressional committees are watched by maybe a few hundred people, certainly not more than 20 million people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大多数国会委员会可能只有几百人观看，肯定不会超过2000万人。

sentences.en: And if you think about it as Americans, I think that showed how seriously the country was taking this, too.
sentences.zh: 如果你从美国人的角度来思考，我认为这也表明了国家对这件事的重视程度。

sentences.en: I believe they really broke ground in terms of how wide and deep the investigation was.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们在调查的广度和深度方面确实取得了突破。

sentences.en: This congressional investigation, again, staffed by former federal prosecutors, got well ahead of the Justice Department for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 这项国会调查，同样由前联邦检察官担任工作人员，在一段时间内远远领先于司法部。

sentences.en: And you could see the Justice Department responding in real time, ramping up their own investigation into January 6th as the January 6th committee put forward evidence.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到司法部在实时做出反应，随着1月6日委员会提出证据，他们加大了对1月6日事件的调查力度。

sentences.en: And then I would say that they did elevate to the country the issue of election denialism.
sentences.zh: 然后我想说，他们确实向全国提升了选举否认主义的问题。

sentences.en: And you could see in polling around the time of this summer when the committee was putting on its hearings that threats to democracy rose to the top of voters' concerns.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到在今年夏天委员会举行听证会期间的民调中，对民主的威胁上升到了选民关注的首位。

sentences.en: And what we actually saw at the midterm elections was voters were smart enough to determine which Republicans were election deniers and which ones weren't.
sentences.zh: 而我们在中期选举中实际看到的是，选民足够聪明，能够判断哪些共和党人是选举否认者，哪些不是。

sentences.en: And those people who really ran on Trump denialism on the 2020 election, those people were rejected.
sentences.zh: 而那些真正以特朗普对2020年选举的否认作为竞选纲领的人，被选民拒绝了。

sentences.en: And that happened in state after state after state.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在州与州之间不断发生。

sentences.en: So to the degree that that day, January 6th, now means something different than it did when these hearings started a year or so ago, what does it mean now to people, do you think?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果说1月6日那一天现在的意义与一年前这些听证会开始时不同，你认为它现在对人们意味着什么？

sentences.en: I think two years ago, when people heard January 6th, they thought of just the storming of the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 我认为两年前，当人们听到1月6日时，他们想到的只是冲击国会大厦。

sentences.en: Now, I think after this committee has finished up its work, January 6th is now more synonymous with a more wide-ranging and longer plot to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为在委员会完成工作后，1月6日现在更多地与推翻选举的更广泛、更长期的阴谋同义。

sentences.en: I think when people think of January 6th,
sentences.zh: 我认为当人们想到1月6日时，

sentences.en: they now think of the fake elector plot and they think of pressuring Vice President Mike Pence and meddling in the Justice Department and all the different ways that Donald Trump tried to cling to power.
sentences.zh: 他们现在想到的是伪造选举人的阴谋，想到的是向副总统迈克·彭斯施压，干预司法部，以及唐纳德·特朗普试图保住权力的所有不同方式。

sentences.en: And so, yes, January 6th did culminate in the storming of the Capitol,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，1月6日确实以冲击国会大厦告终，

sentences.en: but it was only after the seizing of voting machines had been rejected or the plans to invoke martial law had been rejected.
sentences.zh: 但这只是在扣押投票机的计划被拒绝，或者实施戒严的计划被拒绝之后才发生的。

sentences.en: And so I think, big picture,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，从大局来看，

sentences.en: this committee has been successful in broadening the definition of January 6th beyond just the riot and into the widespread plot to overturn an election.
sentences.zh: 委员会成功地将1月6日的定义从单纯的骚乱扩展到了推翻选举的广泛阴谋。

sentences.en: Well, Luke, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，卢克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: The January 6th committee is scheduled to release its full report, including a detailed explanation of its criminal referrals tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 1月6日委员会计划明天发布其完整报告，包括对其刑事移交建议的详细解释。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费访问30天。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A Times investigation has found that the winner of a New York congressional race that helped Republicans win narrow control of the House last month
sentences.zh: 《时报》的一项调查发现，上个月帮助共和党人以微弱优势赢得众议院控制权的一场纽约国会竞选的获胜者，

sentences.en: appears to have fabricated much of his resume.
sentences.zh: 似乎捏造了他简历的大部分内容。

sentences.en: Congressman-elect George Santos of Long Island claims that he graduated from Baruch College, worked at Citigroup and Goldman Sachs, and now runs a non-profit animal rescue group.
sentences.zh: 来自长岛的当选国会议员乔治·桑托斯声称他毕业于巴鲁克学院，曾在花旗集团和高盛工作，现在经营着一家非营利性动物救援组织。

sentences.en: But The Times could find no evidence to support any of those claiMs.
sentences.zh: 但《时报》找不到任何证据来支持这些说法。

sentences.en: Instead, it found records of criminal charges and evictions.
sentences.zh: 相反，它发现了刑事指控和驱逐记录。

sentences.en: And Elon Musk may be stepping down as the CEO of Twitter after he commissioned a poll of its users asking whether he should quit.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克在委托推特用户投票决定他是否应该辞职后，可能会卸任推特首席执行官。

sentences.en: When the poll closed on Monday, a clear majority of respondents said that he should, a verdict that Musk had said he would follow.
sentences.zh: 当民调在周一结束时，绝大多数受访者表示他应该辞职，马斯克曾表示他会遵循这一裁决。

sentences.en: But in the hours since, Musk has taken no action, leaving his future uncertain.
sentences.zh: 但在那之后的几个小时里，马斯克没有采取任何行动，使他的未来充满不确定性。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen, Sidney Harper, and Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮、西德尼·哈珀和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao and Paige Cowett, with help from Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由莱克西·迪奥和佩奇·考特编辑，丽莎·周提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marian Lozano and Rowan Nemisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺和罗文·内米斯托的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时甚至是惊心动魄的斗争的掌控之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的地方收听。
